name: Tivoli Theatre, Brisbane
scope: The original 1915 Tivoli Theatre on Albert Street, Brisbane, as photographed in 1918, including the street entrance, lounge terrace, cantilevered cornice and roof garden auditorium.

originalReview.notes: Street oblique shows the broad dark cornice and gabled rooftop auditorium, side shutters, two narrow arched end bays, recessed three-part foyer window, balcony rail and planters, braced lamp arms and full-width entrance canopy. Albert Street Uniting Church and adjoining businesses provide location context.

review.method: Exact Qualla original with native historical public-domain evidence
review.notes: Qualla was searched first. Its exact 1918 State Library of Queensland photograph matches the native Commons file and is recorded under expired Australian copyright. It is the only image used.
